title: Preserve bar-level clef octave shifts
scope: Model GPIF Bar.Ottavia independently from beat-level octave notation.
acceptance: Retain 8va, 8vb, 15ma and 15mb at their bar/staff locations.
Use a bar clef shift and a different beat octave shift together and preserve both.
Post-parse edits and GP8 export retain exact independent AlphaTab clefOttava values.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].bars[3].clefOttava. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.
Checked all four clef octave shifts across staves, coexistence with a different beat octave, post-parse edits through the pinned consumer, and invalid source/public enum rejection.

evidence.detail: Checked all four clef octave shifts across staffs, simultaneous distinct beat octaves, parsed edits, exact wire/consumer output, and invalid source/public enums. Clef octave and beat octave remain independent.

resolution: Measure.ClefOctave now preserves GPIF Bar.Ottavia independently for every staff measure. Import audits and maps 8va, 8vb, 15ma, and 15mb; validation rejects undefined programmatic values at the exact location; GP8 export writes each authored bar value without changing Beat.Octave. Focused public, wire, reimport, post-parse edit, and pinned AlphaTab evidence covers the complete scoped behavior.
